usedFor: Teamgate holds leads and companies, and Zoho Books holds customers, so “New Company Created” can run “Create or Update Customer”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Company Created” in Teamgate, then “Create or Update Customer” in Zoho Books
bestTemplate.why: A new company gets a customer record for invoicing, and an existing one is updated, not duplicated.

watchOut: “New Company Created” in Teamgate is polling, so the customer appears in Zoho Books after a scheduled check.
